Quote from call: "We need crisp TL;DRs — agents spend 40% of time reading backlogs. If the model can reliably fill fields, our triage time drops a lot."

Key constraints: cost sensitive (tight CAC), need <500ms p50 for short replies in agent-assist flows, throughput ~5-15 rps during peak; fallback behavior required when model fails to produce valid JSON so UI doesn't break. Prefers smaller quantized models for cost (7B/13B) but wants ability to route heavy summarization jobs to larger models. No immediate on-prem requirement — public cloud ok. Security: DPA required, audit logs important for early evaluation, want KMS option later.

POC goals: 1) demonstrate structured-output reliability (>95% valid JSON for 500 sample tickets), 2) measure avg token cost and p50 latency, 3) integrate simple tool-call to create Zendesk ticket via webhook. Success metric: reduce agent first-touch time by 30% on sampled queue.

Sales notes / tone: concise, engineering-minded, will self-serve through API if docs and examples look good. Interested in quickstart node/python snippets, and a templated mapping for Zendesk fields. Pricing sensitivity flagged by CFO on call.
